# @loom/plugin-worker-remote

HTTP WorkerRuntime for Loom — dispatches an ExecutionPackage to a stateless worker's POST /execute endpoint and collects the ExecutionResult

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-worker-remote`

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
